QuestInfo.name: The Black Wings' Plot
QuestInfo.0: You delivered the information from Ereve and Edelstein. You wonder what the Dark Lord will say.
QuestInfo.1: You delivered the information from Ereve and Edelstein. You wonder what the Dark Lord will say.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the information from Ereve and Edelstein to the Dark Lord, who's now almost certain the Black Wings are behind everything. \r\nHe thinks they're trying to make the Explorers distrust each other. \r\nThey're too clever. The Explorers need to be careful.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 60,000
Can proceed to Intruder from Another Dimension

0.0: The more I learn, the more convinced I am that the Black Wings were behind the theft of the Seal Stone.
0.1: I need to tell the other Job Instructors immediately. You may go.

no.0: Did you misunderstand my instructions, Explorer?

yes.0: I suspect the Black Wings disguised themselves as one of us to cause tension within our ranks...
yes.1: A clever plan. We'll need to be on our toes. Who knows what they'll try next.
